about_the_game:
"Daydream" Beta is an adventure puzzle game. The beta version only offers one level and a few simple puzzle-solving mechanics. The full version focuses on story-telling. The story takes place in today's society, with a little girl's school life as the background. During her spare time, she secretly reads some novels and classics to relieve the pressure of studying. Unintentionally, she triggers the ability to enter the world of books. She explores and solves puzzles in the fantasy world and gains valuable experience that she can apply in the real world, making her studies more manageable. Gradually, she develops a positive and optimistic personality, which also influences her classmates.

The beta version features only one character, a young girl in her rebellious teenage years, who is curious about everything and loves to explore and try things out herself. The official version will introduce a boy character. The two characters will help each other and need to cooperate to complete complex tasks.

he beta version only has one dream scene, a cave tomb and a pagoda. The official version has multiple scenes, with real-life scenes and dream scenes alternating. The dream scenes include vanished historical buildings, underwater worlds, hanging gardens, etc. The real-life scenes are mostly realistic settings based on a campus, such as classrooms, playgrounds, basketball courts, dormitories, washrooms, and so on.

The beta version characters only have a set of default student attire. In the official version, based on different dream styles, the characters can obtain clothing that matches the style of the scene, and their faces will also be adorned with makeup that corresponds to the same period as the scene. During the scene, creatures from the same era will also appear to cause trouble for the players.

The beta version currently only has one task: finding the key to open the door and explore the new area. In the official version, finding the key to open the door will be more complicated. One has to find multiple small keys to open small doors before they have a chance to find the key to the main door.

The beta version only offers a few simple puzzle-solving methods, such as lighting candles to break the ropes and complete the road repair. In the official version, the puzzle mechanisms will be more complex, and it is difficult for players to find the solutions at first glance. The puzzles also contain other sub-puzzles, and players need to constantly think to possibly complete the level tasks.

The puzzle-solving method in the beta version is relatively simple and straightforward. In the official version, the puzzle-solving method becomes increasingly complex as the levels progress, and it also varies in form, interweaving with each other to maintain a sense of novelty.

The beta version only triggered a storyline animation when the puzzle was solved. The official version will have a much more diverse and rich storyline, assisting in the world-building and plot development of the game. It will tell players a relatively complete story of their growth.

In the beta version levels, only a magnificent and grand pagoda scene is presented as a reward for the players. In the official version, each chapter will feature a relatively spectacular scene. These scenes are fictional and not described in real-life works. Players enter these scenes through the dream world for experience. For example, the fictional scene 'Nine-Layer Demon Tower' from 'The Ghost Map' is presented realistically to the players in our game.

In the beta version, there was only a relatively peaceful scene of a barren forest at the end. In the final version, a relaxing and peaceful scene would appear at the end of each chapter, allowing players to relax their minds and enter the next section of the adventure.
